column1: # Pizza Pizza nutrition (pizzapizza.ca/about-us/nutrition, "Nutrition facts as of November 1st, 2023"), pulled Oct 1, 2026.
# Classic pizzas only (what MUSC sells): walk-in slice + one slice of a Small/Medium/Large/X-Large pie. Rows the site leaves blank are skipped.
# Fixes: the site prints Sat. Fat without its decimal point ("35" = 3.5 g) whenever it would exceed total fat; those are divided by 10.
